Frequently.title: How much does it cost to develop a game app?
Frequently.desc: The cost of game app development depends on the type of game, features, design, and platform. A simple mobile game development project may start at $10,000, while advanced AR/VR, NFT, or multiplayer games can range up to $80,000 or more.

Frequently.title: How long does it take to build a mobile game?
Frequently.desc: The timeline for mobile game development varies based on complexity. A basic 2D game may take 2–3 months, while a feature-rich 3D, AR/VR, or multiplayer game can take 6–12 months. Our team ensures timely delivery with high-quality results.

Frequently.desc: Yes, Comfygen provides complete post-launch support and game maintenance services. From bug fixes and performance optimization to adding new features, updates, and security enhancements, our team ensures your game stays competitive and delivers a seamless experience to users.
